title: styphelia biflora
intro: Styphelia biflora, commonly known as Mountain pepper, is a plant species native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Styphelia biflora include its ability to relieve pain, reduce fever, and aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
